file_to_url: strip output_dir prefix; strip trailing 'index.html' (root index.html -> '/'); strip trailing '.html' for foo.html files; ensure leading slash
second_source_of_truth: build log 'Writing ... index.html' lines on a clean build
gotchas: Counting *.html overcounts by exactly 1: 404.html is emitted as a flat file and is an error page, not a routable page — exclude it.
The build log's 'Wrote N files' is not the page count: N includes feed.xml, pretty-atom-feed.xsl, sitemap.xml and copied assets; only count 'Writing ...index.html' lines.
The emitted sitemap.xml lists only 9 URLs and deliberately omits all tag-archive pages, so the sitemap undercounts routes and cannot be the second source of truth.

A 'foo.html' file is a page at /foo, distinct from 'foo/index.html' at /foo/ — this starter emits only index.html pages except 404.html, so a pattern of '**/index.html' alone would miss foo.html permalinks in other configs.
Asset passthrough (eleventy-img outputs, dist/*.js bundles) lands inside _site next to pages and must be excluded by extension, not by directory.
When grepping the build log, the root _site/index.html has no path segment before it, so a pattern like '.*/_site/.*/index.html' silently drops the homepage.
